_comment: Copy to config.json, or just run the server once and it generates one. A token is minted automatically on first run.
_provider: Which engine runs the analysis: cli | anthropic | openai | gemini. 'cli' shells out to the Claude CLI and needs no key of its own.
_model: null uses the provider's default (claude-opus-5 / gpt-4o / gemini-2.5-pro).
_apiKeys: Only needed for the API providers. The matching environment variable (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY) always wins, so you can leave this empty and export the key instead. Keys are read by the server only and never reach the browser; this file is written mode 0600.
_headingMacros: Optional. Override only if your template uses macros the parser does not know. Defaults to the list below.
